primary_comparisons: A current reconstruction cost versus history tick
D interval maintenance cost per event versus history interval
D semantic accuracy versus B at each checkpoint
D semantic accuracy and transition-model gap versus E
exclusions: Exclude and rerun only a run interrupted by host, service, storage, or network failure.
Retain malformed model responses, fallback transitions, and semantic errors as results.
Retain every completed seed; do not select seeds by outcome.
Do not combine development seed 7 with confirmatory estimates.

aggregation.center: arithmetic mean across the three seeds
aggregation.spread: sample standard deviation across the three seeds
aggregation.cost_accounting: all inference since tick zero, plus interval costs between checkpoints
aggregation.decision_boundary_for_D: state lookup with zero neural call; lookup latency not claimed

scope: This sweep tests history-length behavior under fixed event probability and fixed active-state size.
It does not test all-dirty C, dependency fan-out, model generalization, hardware portability, or a real-time deadline.
